topic: Lunar dust abrasion on Artemis spacesuits
title: Why Lunar Dust Will Cut Artemis Suits in 2026
description:
NASA's Artemis program faces a silent killer: regolith. It's not just dirt; it's microscopic glass shrapnel that charges up in the vacuum. We break down the physics of why this threatens the 2026 crewed missions and what engineers are doing to stop it.

Watch to the end to see the specific material failure point.

#Artemis #LunarDust #SpaceScience #NASA #2026
